messages.content: You are a technical analyst. Compare the two approaches and produce a structured decision matrix as a markdown table. Columns: Criterion, Approach A, Approach B, Winner. Include at least 5 criteria. End with a one-sentence recommendation. Output ONLY the table and recommendation.

Compare these two approaches for agent memory:

Approach A: Flat-File Memory (MEMORY.md)
- Markdown file as source of truth
- FTS5 search index derived from markdown
- Git-versioned, diffable
- ~1500 token budget frozen at spawn
- Simple CRUD: parse/write markdown sections

Approach B: Embedded Vector Store (SQLite + embeddings)
- SQLite with vector extension for storage
- Semantic search via cosine similarity
- Embedding model required (nomic-embed-text)
- Dynamic retrieval at query time
- Requires model serving infrastructure
